description: A Restricted Item Watcher rule. One preference domain per rule; the domain is com.company.restrict.<rule-name> with a lowercase kebab-case rule name.

ButtonAction.description: Opened when the primary button is pressed: an absolute path or a scheme://… URL. file:// is refused.
ButtonAction.title: Primary button action

CooldownSeconds.description: Dialog rate limit only; the kill happens every time.
CooldownSeconds.title: Dialog cooldown (seconds)

DialogMessage.description: swiftDialog Markdown. Start with “# Title” for a large bold title. Real newlines and blank lines make paragraphs.
DialogMessage.title: Dialog message

DismissButtonText.description: Adds a secondary button that only closes the dialog.
DismissButtonText.title: Dismiss button label

KillProcess.description: Exact process name (pgrep -x / pkill -x). Full names match and may contain spaces, e.g. System Settings.
KillProcess.title: Process to kill

Predicate.description: Present: event-driven rule. Absent: presence rule, polled every 0.5 s.
Predicate.title: Unified-log predicate

WatchProcess.description: Presence rules only: poll this process but still kill KillProcess. Invalid together with Predicate.
WatchProcess.title: Process to watch

title: com.company.restrict.<rule-name>
